q1_issues.issue: The count/uniqueness modifier in "a single vessel" is emitted as an ordinary adjectival property atom (Member (sk_vessel $x) single), which predicates a quality of the vessel rather than recording the stated singleness.

"Thin days" is fused into the compound kind thin_day (with its modifier genus), where the instruction set's parallel case — an adjectivally-restricted bare-plural kind subject, "stray dogs chase cyclists" — makes the restriction a premise conjunct instead, so the rule here only fires on entities explicitly typed thin_day and not on a day typed day + thin.

q2_gaps: "a single N" — an exactness/uniqueness modifier on a singular indefinite: Cardinality is group-only and the "only one N" carrier is a registered gap, so nothing licensed records it

container-measure phrase ("a vessel full of X" as a quantity of X): the instruction set excludes measure of-phrases ("a cup of water") from the genitive rule but supplies no positive encoding, so the only licensed route treats the container itself as the produced object
notes: The adjective-PP-complement reification of "full of mire-essence" (reified state + Experiencer + Of + flat copular atom) and the mire_essence genus are correct, as is Agent for the inanimate transitive subject.
